learning_objective: 🎯 Travel the country through art and learn about the amazing folk and classical dances happening all around us!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Folk dances are happy group dances performed at festivals or harvests, like the energetic Bhangra or the graceful Garba!
Classical dances, like Bharatanatyam or Kathak, take years of practice. They follow very special rules and tell ancient stories.
Every dance has its own magical clothes! Dancers wear heavy bells called ghungroos, shiny jewelry, and bright dresses that twirl when they move.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 My Dream Dance Costume!
fun_activity.instructions: Draw a picture of yourself performing a famous dance from your state. Design the brightest, most colorful costume and jewelry for your drawing!

quick_recap: ⭐ Folk dances are joyful celebrations performed by groups during festivals.
⭐ Classical dances are ancient art forms that require dedication and practice.
⭐ Costumes and jewelry make every dance look unique and spectacular.
